headline: Little kid tells Quando Rondo “You ain’t have to do that to King Von” On November 6, 2020,
body: Little kid tells Quando Rondo “You ain’t have to do that to King Von” On November 6, 2020, outside a hookah lounge in Atlanta, King Von approached Quando Rondo and initiated a physical fight by punching him. During the brawl between their entourages, Quando Rondo did not shoot King Von. Instead, Quando Rondo’s associate, Timothy “Lul Tim” Leeks, stepped in and shot King Von to defend Quando Rondo. Allegations are not findings of guilt.

source_caption_text:
Little kid tells Quando Rondo “You ain’t have to do that to King Von” 💀

On November 6, 2020, outside a hookah lounge in Atlanta, King Von approached Quando Rondo and initiated a physical fight by punching him. During the brawl between their entourages, Quando Rondo did not shoot King Von. Instead, Quando Rondo’s associate, Timothy “Lul Tim” Leeks, stepped in and shot King Von to defend Quando Rondo. King Von died from his gunshot wounds later that morning. Authorities initially charged Leeks with murder, but prosecutors later dropped the charges after determining the shooting was acts of self-defense and defense of others.
